title.narrative: Strengthening Community Resilience through Early Actions for Anticipated Cyclones in Cox's Bazar District, Bangladesh

description.narrative: Objective of the project: To strengthen the resilience of 1,000 vulnerable households in Teknaf Upazila (Teknaf Sadar, Sabrang, Baharchora) by implementing anticipatory actions aimed at minimizing disaster-induced losses from cyclones through multi-purpose cash grants (MPCG), mobility support, WASH facilities, and shelter assistance. Outcome of the project: The project will reduce the impact of cyclones on vulnerable communities, ensuring quicker recovery by safeguarding productive assets, improving evacuation support for at-risk groups, and enhancing access to clean water, safe shelter, and information. Effective coordination will promote security and protect livelihoods in high-risk areas.
The project aim to reach a total of 1,000 HHs and approximately 4220 individuals.

The project focuses on early action and anticipatory measures to minimize the loss of productive assets and strengthen the resilience of 1,000 vulnerable households in Teknaf Upazilla. Key interventions include Multipurpose Cash Grants, information dissemination, mobility support, shelter support, and WASH facilities. The project aims to improve community preparedness and provide direct assistance before and during a cyclone, prioritizing safety, food security, and access to clean water.Activities include coordination with local authorities, early warning dissemination, shelter access guidance, safe water provision, sanitation facilities, cooked food distribution, and evacuation support. Special attention is given to protecting the most vulnerable, such as pregnant women, the elderly, and persons with disabilities. Protection measures against gender-based violence (GBV) and security threats are also outlined, alongside post-distribution monitoring to assess the effectiveness of interventions.Project emphasizes collaboration with local government, community stakeholders, and humanitarian agencies to ensure comprehensive protection and preparedness for the targeted communities.
